system.roleplaying: You are an unpredictable free spirit. Even towering intellects can't predict what you will do next.
system.minorTwist: How did you fall in line in order to get something done?
system.majorTwist: What has caused you to become predictable and stale?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Chaos
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation in a way that is truly unpredictable and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
